description: Rewrites found during plan review that no other item covers: ClickHouseQueryTransformer (platforms/clickhouse/query_transformer.py, used by clickhouse/workload.py:861 and tpchavoc/equivalence.py:587, including its own safe_division/NULLIF and fix_decimal_division_by_zero), StarRocks execute-time rewrites (starrocks/workload.py:500-503: reserved aliases, ANSI SUBSTRING, identifiers, subquery aliases), TPC-DS ClickHouse Q10/Q35 overrides (core/tpcds/benchmark/clickhouse_overrides.py), and the TPC-DS runner's _normalize_interval_syntax and _fix_query58_ambiguity (core/tpcds/benchmark/runner.py:543-584). Move the mechanism into the fork as generator behavior or named rewrites; ClickHouse division reuses the safe_division option. Query ids and benchmark names stay in BenchBox.
